units.source_text: 名人下这一手，考虑了二十七分钟，是在上午十一时三十四分下的。

en.t: The Master took twenty-seven minutes to consider this move, and played it at 11:34 in the morning.

units.source_text: 经过近半个小时的思考，下错了棋，虽是偶然，可他为什么不拖延一个小时，留待午休以后再下？

en.t: After nearly half an hour of thought, he made a wrong move; even if it was accidental, why did he not delay for an hour and leave it until after the lunch break?

units.source_text: 大概离开棋盘，休息一小时，他会有正着吧，难道他是被过路的妖魔缠身了吗？

en.t: If he had left the board and rested for an hour, he probably would have found the correct move; could he really have been possessed by some passing demon?

units.source_text: 白的时间还余下二十三个小时，拖延一两个小时是不成问题的。

en.t: White still had twenty-three hours of time remaining, so delaying for an hour or two would have been no problem.

units.source_text: 名人不把午休当作战术使用。

en.t: The Master did not use the lunch break as a tactic.
Black 131, however, ran into the lunch break.
